index_reference: original MAT sample rows, before any shuffle or filtering
group_identity_limit: Exact equality over all stored raw feature views only; no claim of original image identity or near-duplicate detection.
feature_preprocessing: NOT_FITTED; train-only fit for selection, outer-train-only refit for final evaluation
full_label_access: Preparation-only stratification and label-support summaries; no model training or evaluation.

training_protocol.needs_validation: Train on train_idx (~64%), select on val_idx (~16%), directly evaluate on test_idx (~20%).
training_protocol.no_validation: Train on outer_train_idx (~80%), directly evaluate on the same test_idx (~20%).
training_protocol.outer_train_idx: Outer training pool; refitting a model selected on val_idx is optional, not required.
